text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian President Kiro Gloigorov appealed for tolerance and dialogue between Macedonians and Albanians in the Macedonian parliament.
- Parliament adopted the declaration on inter-ethnic relations in Macedonia proposed by the government.
- Students protesting in front of the Macedonian parliament have stopped the hunger strike. They said protests would continue but this time demands would be resignation of the whole government.

- Deputies from Albanian PDP and PDPA demanded changes in the Macedonian constitution. They ask for status of a constituent nation, Albanian as an official language and all other guarantees for the equality of citizens of Macedonia.
